jobs.title: Event Security Officers – Level II & Level III
jobs.description:
We are seeking professional, dependable, and experienced security officers to support event operations alongside event staff, venue security, local law enforcement.

Positions Available

  • Level II Non-Commissioned Security Officers
  • Level III Commissioned Security Officers

Level II Non-Commissioned Security OfficerPosition Summary

Level II Officers will provide professional, uniformed security support throughout the event. Officers will primarily be assigned to access-control, observation, guest-flow, and security-presence posts.

Responsibilities

  • Staff assigned security posts, including entrances, interior doorways, stairwells, corridors, registration areas, and other designated locations.
  • Maintain a professional and visible security presence.
  • Monitor assigned areas for unauthorized access, disturbances, suspicious activity, safety concerns, or violations of event policies.
  • Assist with orderly guest movement and crowd flow.
  • Provide basic directions and assistance to guests when appropriate.
  • Report security incidents or concerns through the established chain of command.
  • Assist event leadership, venue security, and law enforcement personnel as directed.
  • Respond appropriately to disturbances, safety concerns, or medical incidents until relieved by emergency personnel.
  • Remain at your assigned post unless properly relieved or directed otherwise.
  • Complete required incident documentation.

Important: Event personnel, not Level II officers, will have primary responsibility for validating invitations and checking guest identification.

Level II Requirements

  • Current Texas DPS Non-Commissioned Security Officer (Level II) license, or higher applicable Texas security license.
  • Must be eligible for affiliation with RKSMS through the Texas Online Private Security system prior to the event.
  • Must have completed all required Texas training and licensing requirements.
  • Level II officers will not carry firearms while performing security duties.
  • Professional appearance and conduct.
  • Strong communication and situational-awareness skills.
  • Ability to remain standing and attentive for extended periods.

Level III Commissioned Security OfficerPosition Summary

Level III Officers will provide armed security coverage at strategically designated locations throughout the event. Officers will supplement Level II personnel and support areas requiring an elevated security presence and rapid-response capability.

Responsibilities

  • Staff designated armed-security posts at higher-risk or strategically important locations.
  • Maintain a professional and highly visible armed-security presence.
  • Monitor assigned areas for threats, disturbances, unauthorized access, suspicious activity, and safety concerns.
  • Provide immediate security response when directed by event leadership.
  • Assist with de-escalation and management of security incidents within the officer's authority and training.
  • Coordinate with event leadership, venue security, and law enforcement when necessary.
  • Maintain strict firearms safety, weapons-retention, and use-of-force discipline.
  • Remain at the assigned post unless properly relieved or redirected.
  • Complete required incident documentation.

Level III Requirements

  • Current and active Texas DPS Commissioned Security Officer (Level III) license.
  • Must be eligible for affiliation prior to the event.
  • Completion of required Level III training, testing, and firearms qualification.
  • Must meet all applicable Texas DPS firearms requirements.
  • Must be qualified with the type/category of firearm authorized for use at the event.
  • Strong situational awareness, communication, and professional judgment.
  • Ability to remain attentive and professional in a large, high-profile event environment.

Ideal Candidates

We are looking for security professionals who are:

  • Licensed and in good standing with Texas DPS.
  • Reliable and punctual.
  • Professional and customer-service oriented.
  • Comfortable working in a large-scale event environment.
  • Able to follow post orders and the established chain of command.
  • Experienced with crowd management, access control, event security, or similar assignments.

Pay: $19.00 - $21.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

Andy Frain Services is on the lookout for a motivated and detail-oriented Event Operations Manager to play a key role in driving event operations across our premier Sports & Entertainment venues. You will primarily focus on Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this dynamic role, you will partner directly with the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead the security team, and ensure exceptional safety and experiences for fans, promoters, sponsors, and vendors.

Work Schedule Note: Flexibility is essential as this position involves a dynamic, event-driven schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on the venue calendar.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Opportunities for leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader

Key Responsibilities

Event Operations & Venue Leadership

  • Act as the operational lead for smaller events and manage concurrent venue dates across Dallas.
  • Oversee event-day execution, ensuring that security requirements and client standards are met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and manage accurate post-event payroll and billing.
  • Serve as the primary lead in the Account Manager's absence.

Staffing, Onboarding & Development

  • Assist in the onboarding, training, scheduling, and management of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Conduct pre-event briefings for teams of varying sizes, from small groups to over 600 personnel.
  • Monitor monthly event metrics and assess staff performance indicators.
  • Coach and mentor supervisors and staff on personnel matters in accordance with company policy.

Logistics & Equipment Management

  • Oversee the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue equipment.
  • Prepare operational materials and documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of the operational needs.

Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations

  • Identify and address potential safety risks for guests and staff.
  • Regularly meet with venue clients to ensure security, emergency preparedness, and safety compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.

Job Title: AT&T Stadium - Event Staff

Company: BEST Crowd Management

Location: AT&T Stadium

Pay: $14 / hr

Summary:

Join the dynamic and customer-focused team at BEST Crowd Management as an Event Services Staff member. As a part of our Event Services Staff, you will be an essential part of creating memorable experiences for event attendees. We are seeking individuals who are enthusiastic, reliable, and passionate about delivering exceptional customer service.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide outstanding customer service by greeting and assisting event attendees with a friendly and helpful demeanor.
  • Assist with event set-up, including equipment arrangement, signage placement, and other tasks as assigned.
  • Monitor event areas to ensure cleanliness, orderliness, and compliance with venue policies.
  • Answer questions and provide information about the event, facilities, and amenities to attendees.
  • Direct attendees to appropriate locations, such as seating areas, restrooms, concession stands, and exits.
  • Handle and resolve customer inquiries, complaints, or issues in a professional and timely manner.
  • Collaborate with event staff, vendors, and other team members to ensure smooth event operations.
  • Assist with crowd control measures, as necessary, to maintain a safe and enjoyable environment for all attendees.
  • Adhere to company policies, procedures, and guidelines to uphold a high standard of professionalism and service excellence.

Requirements:

  • Be at least 18 years old (age requirements may vary depending on local regulations).
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent (some college education is preferred).
  • Previous experience in customer service, hospitality, or event-related roles is advantageous.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to interact effectively with diverse individuals.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to remain calm and professional in high-pressure situations.
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays, based on event schedules.
  • Physical stamina to stand, walk, and engage in physical activities for extended periods.
  • Demonstrated reliability, punctuality, and a strong work ethic.

Benefits:

  • Enjoy competitive pay based on your experience and qualifications.
  • Take advantage of opportunities for career growth and advancement within the company.
  • Enhance your skills and knowledge through training and development programs.
  • Benefit from flexible scheduling options to accommodate your personal needs.
  • Be part of a positive and supportive work environment that values diversity and inclusion.

Note: At BEST Crowd Management, we believe in equal opportunities for all applicants and employees.

We highly appreciate the contributions and perspectives that each individual brings to our team.

Minimum Education and Experience

High school diploma or GED and a minimum of thirty (30) semester hours from an accredited college or university. One (1) year of continuous employment, part time or full time, as a police guard, dispatcher, telecommunications operator, other qualifying positions or other related experience with a component institution of the University of Texas System, as determined by the Chief of Police. Personal computer, calculator. Normal office conditions, occasional travel. Proficiency and accuracy in all phases of duties performed. Requires ability to develop a thorough knowledge of University structure, policies, rules and procedures and of appropriate business practices and techniques. Must possess a valid Texas driver's license and be eligible to drive a University owned and/or leased motor vehicle. Must successfully pass a thorough background investigation.

Preferred Education and Experience

Other Qualifications

To the extent this position requires the holder to research, work on, or have access to critical infrastructure as defined in Section 117.001(2) of the Texas Business and Commerce Code, the ability to maintain the security or integrity of the critical infrastructure is a minimum qualification to be hired and to continue to be employed in the position.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
  • Maintain a schedule of pending campus events
  • Coordinate with key university managers on special event risk assessments
  • Coordinate and implement law enforcement/security functions
  • Communicate and brief operational plans with institution partners
  • Ensure appropriate safety and security measures are addressed and in place prior to major events on campus


Training Will Be Provided in the following, but not limited to:
  • National Incident Management System (NIMS)/Incident Command System (ICS)
  • Institution/Department Emergency Plans
  • Special Event Planning and Operations and Risk Assessment


Work with the department intelligence officer to monitor intelligence sources for relevant information that may affect the assessment rating and/or planning elements. If the risk assessment changes before the event, you will ensure the information is communicated appropriately to relevant institutional partners and necessary changes are made to account for the increased or decreased risk. Review event organizers and/or sponsors to ensure any involved businesses or entities are not a convicted felon, habitual offender, member of an outlaw motorcycle gang, member of an organized criminal street gang identified as such, member of a drug trafficking organization, is not engaged in prostitution or human trafficking or otherwise of disreputable character or reputation. Be able to communicate through the chain of command, the event plan as well as brief the officers involved.

Physical Demands and Working Conditions

Duties involve driving, walking, running, standing, stooping, climbing, crouching, pushing, jumping over, pulling, carrying, reaching above head, lifting, lowering, hand-wrist and elbow motion, grasping, and holding. Also, must be able to lift 40 to 50lbs occasionally.

Most of the work will be performed in normal office conditions, however outside activities/events could require your attendance. You must be able to perform with proficiency and accuracy in all your duties. Must be able to adapt to university structure, policy, rules and regulations and be able to perform the job duties within those parameters. Must possess a valid Texas driver's license and be eligible to drive a university owned and/or leased motor vehicle. Must successfully pass a thorough background investigation.
